sources_used: https://www.doc.govt.nz/parks-and-recreation/places-to-go/otago/places/queenstown-area/ (page is script-rendered; only the Queenstown day walks brochure PDF link was readable, not parsed)

gaps.name: Fergburger
gaps.reason: Wikivoyage's Queenstown Eat list calls it legendary and insanely busy, it has its own Wikipedia article (about 11.7k views/yr) and the app's own Queenstown tip already tells visitors to beat its queue. A venue that is itself a recognised attraction, the one individual eatery COVERAGE.md lets through.

gaps.name: Coronet Peak
gaps.reason: Named in Wikivoyage's Queenstown Skiing list as the closest ski field (about 20 min by sealed road); Wikipedia article, about 7.8k views. About 13 km from the centre, inside the 22.5 km span.

gaps.name: The Remarkables
gaps.reason: Named in Wikivoyage Skiing and Understand; Wikipedia article is the most-viewed Queenstown-area natural feature after Lake Wakatipu (about 23k views). Pin sits at the ski-area road end (visitor point, about 12 km), not the range centroid.

gaps.name: Lake Hayes
gaps.reason: Wikivoyage Queenstown-Lakes names it as the popular swimming lake near Arrowtown; Wikipedia notes a circuit track on the Queenstown Trail. About 13 km from centre.

gaps.name: Queenstown Hill
gaps.reason: Wikivoyage Do/Hiking: climbed in about 3/4 hours for a fantastic view and free. Wikipedia article exists (Time Walk). 3 km from centre.

gaps.name: Skippers Canyon
gaps.reason: Wikipedia calls Skippers Road one of New Zealand's better-known scenic roads; about 8k views/yr and a staple of Queenstown tourism. Only a Wikipedia source was retrieved (the DOC page is script-rendered). The place is the canyon, not the 4WD or jet tours that go there.

gaps.name: Macetown
gaps.reason: Wikivoyage Arrowtown Do lists the trip into Macetown; Wikipedia says it is a tourist attraction and lists it under Tourist attractions in Otago. About 22 km straight-line from centre, borderline but inside the 22.5 km span; reached from Arrowtown.

gaps.name: Arrowtown Chinese Settlement
gaps.reason: Wikivoyage Arrowtown See (the second entry) and its own Wikipedia article. Distinct place from the Arrowtown village spot, which currently mentions it in its bio; coordinator may trim that bio to avoid overlap.

gaps.name: Lakes District Museum
gaps.reason: First entry in Wikivoyage Arrowtown See (the town's museum and information centre), with listed hours and price. No English Wikipedia article.

gaps.name: Kiwi Park
gaps.reason: Wikivoyage Queenstown See lists Kiwi Park (Kiwi Birdlife Park) with hours and price; central, 0.6 km from the centre. Venue was renamed Kiwi Park Queenstown; Wikimedia Commons category is Kiwi Park.

gaps.name: Queenstown Trail
gaps.reason: Wikipedia article and in Category:Queenstown-Lakes District; a cycle and walking network linking town, Arrowtown, Jack's Point and Gibbston, the same kind of spot as the Otago Central Rail Trail. Wikivoyage's Do section also sends cyclists along it to Arrowtown.

gaps.name: Walter Peak High Country Farm
gaps.reason: The place at the end of the TSS Earnslaw sailing; replaces the TSS Earnslaw spot (see existing_fixes). About 13 km from centre across the lake.

gaps.name: Kingston
gaps.reason: Wikivoyage lists Kingston as a Queenstown-Lakes settlement and the base of the Kingston Flyer. About 33 km straight line (47 km by road), outside Queenstown's span, so a standalone spot. Check it does not fall within another destination's span.

gaps.name: Kingston Flyer
gaps.reason: A heritage steam train (vehicle/operator) at a village that is proposed as the spot; mentioned in Kingston's bio instead.

gaps.name: Crown Range Road / Summit lookout
gaps.reason: A road (the way you get to Wanaka/Cardrona); the summit is about 25 km from the centre, outside the span, and it is reached on the way to Wanaka. Could be a standalone lookout spot if a source names a distinct viewpoint; none was found.

gaps.name: Lake Wakatipu
gaps.reason: The lake is the setting of the whole destination (already its tagline and the Queenstown Gardens/Skyline views), not a separate stop; no distinct visitor point beyond the lakefront.

gaps.name: Moke Lake
gaps.reason: Only a Wikipedia stub was found; the DOC page that would list the campsite and walk could not be read. Reconsider if the DOC Queenstown popular-places list confirms it. About 8 km from centre.

gaps.name: Nevis Bungy / Nevis Highwire Platform
gaps.reason: Bungy operator, and about 29 km from centre (outside span); Kawarau Gorge Suspension Bridge already covers the bungy story.

gaps.name: Bannockburn
gaps.reason: Wine area near Cromwell, belongs to Central Otago.

gaps.name: Cardrona Alpine Resort / Cardrona
gaps.reason: About 40 km away over the Crown Range; belongs to the Wanaka destination (Cardrona Hotel already is a Wanaka spot).

gaps.name: Highlands Motorsport Park
gaps.reason: At Cromwell, about 33 km east; belongs to Central Otago.

gaps.name: Paradise (Glenorchy area)
gaps.reason: Not a Queenstown spot: about 40 km up the lake, beyond the span. COVERAGE.md's benchmark requires it as a Glenorchy-area spot; it is absent from spots.ts (only the standalone Glenorchy exists), so coordinator should check the Glenorchy/Mount Aspiring runs cover it.

gaps.name: Ledge Bungy, Ziptrek, Luge, Nevis Catapult, Kawarau Jet and other operators
gaps.reason: Operators/experiences; the place is Bob's Peak (Skyline), the Kawarau bridge or the river.

gaps.name: Queenstown Arts Centre, Ivan Clarke Gallery
gaps.reason: Small town galleries with one source listing each; a gallery strip, not a stop that draws travellers (COVERAGE.md 'town galleries').

gaps.name: Millbrook Resort
gaps.reason: A golf resort and hotel, not a place visitors tour.

gaps.name: Cecil Peak, Bowen Peak, Mount Alfred, Hidden Island
gaps.reason: Peaks and islets seen from town with no visitor access or low visitation; Ben Lomond and Queenstown Hill already cover the climbs.

gaps.name: One Mile Creek Power Station, Sunshine Bay, Kelvin Peninsula, Jack's Point, Arthurs Point, Edith Cavell Bridge, Frankton Arm
gaps.reason: Suburbs and local heritage items that few visitors go to (the 'ordinary suburban park' case).

gaps.name: Shotover River
gaps.reason: Covered by Shotover Jet (existing) and the proposed Skippers Canyon.

gaps.name: Kawarau Gibbston Dark Sky Park
gaps.reason: Designation over the Gibbston valley, no distinct stop; Gibbston Valley already a spot.

existing_fixes.reason: TSS Earnslaw is a vehicle/operator: COVERAGE.md names it explicitly. Replace with the place at the end of the sailing, keep the steamship in the bio and RealNZ in ticketUrl. Keep the id queenstown-4 (never reused) or retire it, coordinator's call; the replacement entry is in new_spots with photo null, because Walter Peak High Country Farm has no English Wikipedia article (`wiki` null) so the default lead-image lookup finds nothing and an override would need to be added (the only Commons farm photos found carry an overlaid caption). Also drop any WIKI_IMAGE_OVERRIDES entry for TSS Earnslaw.

existing_fixes.to: Shotover River (wiki: Shotover River), keep the jet-boat operator in ticketUrl
existing_fixes.reason: Judgment call, low confidence: 'Shotover Jet' is an operator ride whose place is the Shotover River canyons; COVERAGE.md says to name the place unless the ride is the attraction with no distinct place. Leave as is if the coordinator considers the jet ride itself the attraction. The bio and ticketUrl already read fine.

existing_fixes.to: Ben Lomond Track trailhead/saddle (Wikipedia's summit is -45.007, 168.6156; OSM Queenstown Hill walkway entrance -45.0274, 168.6667 is not it)
existing_fixes.reason: Low-priority coordinate check: the pin (-44.9900, 168.6250) is about 2 km north of the Wikipedia summit coordinate, and the bio describes the summit climb. Run scripts/audit-spot-coordinates.ts for it and place at the track start (top of the Skyline gondola) or the summit; not changed here.

new_spots.name: Skippers Canyon
new_spots.coordinates_source: Wikipedia Skippers Canyon coordinates; OSM way Skippers Bridge -44.8443,168.6869 is the far (northern) end

new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: none: reached by many 4WD tour operators and by self-drive (rental insurance is not honoured on Skippers Road per Wikipedia)
new_spots.note: Photo checked against the category 'Skippers Canyon' on Commons: shows the canyon road and walkers.

new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: none (no official single site / not applicable)
new_spots.note: No photo: only archival and a mountain-bike photo were found.
